decisions.question: Which customer-account mode, sign-in-link state, account configuration, and store plan are currently active?
Is the MVP limited to Shopify-native orders, addresses, profile, and Buy again?
What evidence establishes current machine ownership, correction, transfer, revocation, and authorized viewing?
Are registration and serial collection necessary, and what effect if any do they have on warranty?
What private system of record, access model, retention, deletion/export, and incident owner govern ownership and service data?
Which manual files and Product mappings are current, accessible, rights-cleared, and approved for account delivery?
Which warranty policy versions and Product mappings may produce a customer-visible status?
Is private support history valuable enough to fund a custom app/backend and operating process?
Does Rhino have an approved dealer/wholesale program, eligibility process, catalogs, pricing, payment terms, and account owner?
Who approves tax exemption evidence and ongoing tax treatment?
Which purchase-order workflow, approval limits, payment terms, and reconciliation owner are approved?
Which optional retention features justify app, data, privacy, accessibility, performance, and recurring-cost exposure?
What recommendation rules and evidence prevent compatibility or warranty inferences?
What transactional versus marketing consent, cadence, audience, and stop rules govern reminders and onboarding?
decisions.authority: Privacy + Legal + Marketing + Epic X owner

deferredEpicInterfaces.boundary: No search, filter, collection, or general discovery implementation in Epic O.
Saved comparison may preserve an interface only; comparison logic and buying guidance remain post-O.
Account resource links may consume approved content; broader education strategy remains post-O.
No review, testimonial, rating, or social-proof restart in Epic O.
